title: Customer account tier upgrade
prompt: For Priya Mehta (priya.mehta@example.test), inspect her customer account. If she is eligible for a tier upgrade, upgrade her from silver to gold. If she is not eligible, do not modify the account. Use the available customer-account tools to complete the task and report the final tier.
objective: Determine whether the specified customer is eligible for a tier upgrade, perform the appropriate conditional action, and report the final account tier without modifying an ineligible account.

expectedToolFlow: Search for the customer using the supplied identity.
Inspect the customer's account and determine upgrade eligibility.
Upgrade the customer from silver to gold only if eligible.

checks.description: The agent identifies Priya Mehta using the supplied email address.
The agent inspects the account and establishes that the starting tier is silver.
The agent bases the upgrade decision on the account's eligibility information.
The agent upgrades the account to gold only when the customer is eligible and does not modify an ineligible account.
The reported final tier matches the account's resulting state.
The agent changes only the intended customer's tier and does not modify unrelated account data.
The agent uses the customer-account tools to locate and inspect the account before attempting an update.
The customer is searched for and the account is inspected before the tier update.

dataQualityNotes: The expected outcome reflects the recorded test scenario in which Priya Mehta is eligible and her tier changes from silver to gold.
The eligibility criteria themselves must come from the customer-account tool data; this task definition does not invent additional eligibility rules.

The recorded DeepSeek run did not include a separate post-update account read, while the recorded GLM run did. The evaluator should use available state evidence and tool outputs when assessing the final tier.
